programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: The lives of an architect and his wife are turned upside down when a stranger kidnaps their daughter and blackmails them to do some crimes for him.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kaam
programme.desc: Two petty thieves, Raja and Balu, take refuge in Anjali's house while escaping from the police. When Raja learns about Anjali's misery, he decides to help her.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Antardwand
programme.desc: Mani, a spoiled brat, is brought up in a caste-ridden society. When he is sent to his uncle's house for studies, he finds his life entangled in a situation of love, revenge and gratitude.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: Karthik and Vyshali, a newly-wed couple, move into a villa and start living together. Soon, Karthik realises that his wife is a ghost and decides to get rid of her.

programme.desc: S3 E25 — Moon Girl and the Dino Dilemma; Hulk's Squirrley SwitchThe Spideys team up with Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur to stop Green Goblin's dino-mech. When Doc Ock swaps Hulk into the body of a squirrel, Squirrel Girl helps save him.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts and the Curious PenguinWanting to get his very own Octo-Watch and make his brother proud, Pinto helps Dashi on some missions with Paani and Koshi.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Mission Turtle TroubleLauchie plans to bring Moss to take-your-pet-to-school day, but a jealous Silver Paw turtle-naps her. Can Jeremy and Deena find her in time for the morning school run?

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S1 E14 — LostGinger and the baby Pea-Rexes search for honeysuckle, leaving behind a trail of berries to help find their way back. But when Wasabi eats the trail, they're stranded in the dark.

programme.title: GiggleQuiz
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Ann Teak's Antique WandJoining Gail and Keith for today's GiggleQuiz are the Lost Pirate and Ann Teak. Keith finds an old stick under his desk, and Ann Teak gives her 'expert' opinion on what it is. Ann declares that the artefact must be a conductor's baton and demonstrates how to use it. Unbeknownst to Ann, the stick is actually a magic wand and waving it around causes Arthur's phone to turn into a pineapple. Throughout the third round, Ann Teak obliviously performs her own magic spells in the studio.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Chip's ThemeChip sings a heartfelt song about being a potato. Though he can't do many physical things, he is proud of who he is.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Molly's CinemaMolly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack's stall. She chooses the cinema ticket and remembers the day she got it. Alice is telling the kids a story at the Kids Club. Molly thinks her dad, James, and Alice are getting on very well. When Bob finds an old film projector at a jumble sale, Molly has an idea. She tells Mack that she wants James and Alice to get married! Mack explains that adults can't just get married; they have to have a date first.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Ryan's Vietnamese Pork and Prawn ChaRyan's mum is Vietnamese, and he is cooking a dish from Vietnam that she has taught him. He works hard in the kitchen mixing lots of ingredients together, including pork, prawns and fresh mint. He even finds time to teach us the Vietnamese word for egg! One of Ryan's ingredients is fresh mint, but not all of Ryan's friends like the taste or smell of it at first.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E8 — PuddlesRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how puddles play an important role in the environment. They find out that puddles are part of the water cycle and that they can support birds, animals, insects and plants too. They learn how raindrops and lakes can be a bit like puddles, and on the way, there is plenty of puddle-splashing fun to be had.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Cucumbers and LobstersStorm goes to East Lothian where lobsters are growing, JB discovers how computers and spiders help cucumbers grow on a farm in Essex, and some children from a beach club in Scotland comb the sand to help the wildlife.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S2 E11 — Waffle Tries to Be GoodWhen Jess takes Evie for her first school visit, Waffle goes along too, on the condition that he doesn't sing. He tries his best to behave, but it's hard for a Wonder Dog! On their walk to school, Jess and Evie bump into Connie Lester and her daughter Ruby. Ruby reveals that she will also be starting at Sommersby School too, in the year above Evie. Ruby enjoys stroking Waffle and tells Evie that she loves animals. She has a pet dog of her own, Jelly, a yellow Labrador.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E33 — The Island BadgeDuggee and the Squirrels are sailing. When Tag starts to feel seasick, Duggee suggests they stop at the island. However, someone steals their boat and all their food! Duggee has his island badge and knows what to do.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S5 E2 — Blue Whale RescueWhen Kwazii discovers a blue whale with an injured tail, the Octonauts attempt to use a giant net and Octofloats to keep it from sinking. Meanwhile, Peso and Tweak collaborate on a special brace for its tail, and Kwazii, Dashi and Shellington try to find it enough food. But when the supporting net breaks, the Octonauts have to launch an emergency free-fall rescue.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: S1 — Tidbit's Watermelon WorryTidbit worries that a watermelon will grow in his tummy after he swallows a seed.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E6 — The Continent of EuropeTala decides to focus a class project on her uncle Glitch's souvenir selfies from Europe - but little does she know that all of his pictures are atrocious. A panicking Glitch gets help from the Go Jetters, and using a series of cardboard cut-outs they start to take photos all across the continent - but can they help out when Glitch gets himself into a sticky situation?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: S1 E27 — The Day Ammon Overcame Her FearAmmon gets spooked by a tiny insect, but overcomes her fear to rescue Cosima and Big Lizard from the rapids.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E31 — You Can Do It YukeeWhen a radio station decides to broadcast from Yukee's garden, she finds herself with an unexpected guest spot.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Birthday PartyOn Alex's birthday, the Froglets lift off in a hot-air balloon for a high-flying party.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S10 E6 — We're All Friends: GrowingMr Tumble helps Grandad Tumble water his vegetables - and lots of splashing fun is had! Meanwhile, Justin and his friends have fun gardening and making a scarecrow.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Spring:Climbing PlantsAaron and the Buds learn how climbing plants grow tall and reach for the sun!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S2 — Shoes DayThe pups get to wear their favourite pair of shoes to school.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S2 — Ping Pong WafflePing-pong is off-limits to Waffle until the after-schoolers invent Waffle Pong. Meanwhile, Mrs Hobbs reveals her table tennis tricks.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E40 — Bad MoodBingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Nikhil and Jay
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Nikhil and Jay and the Turmeric SuperpowerJay gets turmeric on his hands and turns everything yellow and wonders if the whole world will turn yellow because of his turmeric superpower.

programme.title: Tish Tash
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Fish CakePola, Tish and Bobby decorate a cake for Rosa, and Tish suggests it should be a fish cake with a chocolate truffle as its eye.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Drum DramaFine Forest is buzzing with excitement as the Fine Forest Drums Festival approaches. The Piggies make a lot of drums for everyone, but they mysteriously disappear. The Piggies create a huge drum and hide inside to uncover this mystery.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S1 E23 — Topsy Turvy DayToday is Topsy Turvy Day, a day when everyone has to do things the opposite way to how they'd normally do them. This confuses Love Monster, especially after he wakes up to hear Elder Kitten wishing everyone a good evening.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Mission Pink PrankSilver Paw plots to throw Dad's red underwear into the wash to turn Scarlett's football kit pink. To save the day, Jeremy must confront his fear of heights in a nail-biting, high-wire clothesline crossing.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Dylan the Dino ExpertDylan the dinosaur expert wants to discover dinosaur bones, but assembling them into a dinosaur-shape is a lot harder than finding them!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: S2 E34 — Prickly's PanicAs the Sweetwood Explorers head to Twinkle Cave, Vida helps Prickly calm down and enjoy the trip.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Splat!The Wonderblocks help Arty figure out how to make the perfect pattern for Toad.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Slime SistersWhen the sensational singing snail sisters take a wrong direction and end up in the garden, Sonny offers to take them where they need to go. As a thank you, they give a special concert.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Five Little DucksLisa and the children float rubber ducks and sign and sing `Five Little Ducks'.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: S1 E9 — SpiderNick and his grandson Remie create a podcast song about a spider who lives in a bucket.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E26 — The Piris' Inky IssueThe Piris take refuge in grumpy Millie the squid's cave during a storm but accidentally damage a painting. Can they find a clever way to fix it before Millie finds out?

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Twiggy's Tummy AcheTwiggy has a funny tummy on the day of his performance. Nothing the doctors try works, not even the cure for froggy moths! Zog wonders if there is something else bothering Twiggy.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Tallest WishRafi's tall wish shows that growing up too fast can mean missing the joy of being little.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E45 — HandstandAt a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna can't find a way to make herself useful. They're both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Autumn: It's Time to Play FootballJoJo meets Ezra's grandson Jaxon, and they join Jared, Cynthia, Ezra and Terrence for a football match in the park, with Gran Gran as the referee. The game goes well, but JoJo doesn't score any goals.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Puffins Vs FoxesIsabelle and Oona visit Mossy, only to find him absent. Concerned, Oona enlists Flynne's help. The unlikely trio sets off to search for their missing friend.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: S3 E26 — I've Got Nobody to Play WithCharlie is going out and Lotta has a cold, which means that Lola has no one to play with until she remembers her imaginary friend, Soren Lorenson.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: S1 E22 — Moon Baby in the Tub!In the Toy House, everybody is reading books when the little toy tub appears. Moon Baby catches it. In Storyland, the big tub appears, and Moon Baby decides he will catch that, too.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Up and Down and Upside DownMemo and Baba explore up, down and upside down in many different forms.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Makka Pakka Gets LostMakka Pakka sets off through the garden looking for stones, but he loses his way. Which way is home? No need to worry, because here comes the Pinky Ponk.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2024 E34 — Shirley Ballas: Big DanceShirley Ballas reads 'Big Dance' by Aoife Greenham on the 'CBeebies Bedtime Story' dance floor.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Charles IIAmber Butchart explores the lives of historical figures through the clothes they wore. Here, she looks at Charles II.

programme.title: Lesley Garrett at the BBC
programme.desc: A tribute to the remarkable voice and career of the great soprano Lesley Garrett, who shares her memories of some of her finest performances on the BBC.

programme.title: The Riviera: A History in Pictures
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Golden EraAs transatlantic liners brought America's super-rich to the region, art and celebrity became integrally intertwined as cultural gurus and multi-millionaires all partied on the beach. In an era of sunshine and bathing, of cinema and fast cars, of the Ballet Russes and Monte Carlo casinos, Richard E Grant discovers the extraordinary output of what became briefly the world's creative hub.

programme.title: An Inspector Calls
programme.desc: The mysterious 'Inspector Goole' interrupts a wealthy family's family party to tell them a young woman committed suicide that night. But what's that got to do with them? One by one, they will find out, as their shattering, dark secrets are revealed.

programme.title: An Evening with JB Priestley
programme.desc: In a programme first broadcast in 1973 as he entered his 80th year, JB Priestley chooses extracts from his own writing to celebrate some of the many different things that he looks back on with pleasure.

programme.title: Organ Stops: Saving the King of Instruments
programme.desc: One hundred years ago, pipe organs and organ music were found across Britain, but the steady closure of churches and venues has seen the loss of many instruments. Follow the tireless efforts of a small band of organ enthusiasts to save, restore and re-home pipe organs. Martin Renshaw dedicates his life to travelling the UK on organ rescue missions, and sound engineer Marc Ogier rebuilds instruments in his back bedroom from pipes bought online.

programme.desc: S2 E10 — GrapefruitLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit dedicating the song `All My Friends' to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Talkie TaxiBing and Sula discover a new toy at Amma's crèche - a talking ride-on car. It seems like fun until talkie taxi keeps saying the same thing over and over again. When the taxi crashes and is finally silenced, Bing and Sula use their imagination to play the game they really want to play.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E42 — WashingPo eats Tubby Custard and gets a messy bib. Po washes the bib clean and hangs it out to dry before eating more Tubby Custard with Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S1 E7 — ColdIt's a cold day and Tee wants to play outside. Mo agrees, but only if he puts on enough layers. A fun dress-up game ensues!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E27 — The Sorting ExpressRed and Yellow sort different coloured objects onboard the Sorting Express. Learn to spot the difference between colours and shades with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S2 E4 — GovernmentDad uses Bingo's back as a typewriter to type a letter to the government, demanding they do something about his errant children. Bingo tries their best to make sure the letter says exactly what she wants.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E15 — ShopWhile looking for things to sell in their shop, Bing and Sula find their old friend Mr Rainbow, but his head is completely gone. So they decide to sell him, and after a nice lady buys his stacky bit for her toilet rolls, they look for some more things to sell. But then they find Mr Rainbow's head and are sad that they can't get the rest of him back. However, Charlie loves to knock down Mr Rainbow's rings.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E36 — CliffhangerFelix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They'll need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E10 — The Cheese BadgeDuggee and the Squirrels go on a mission to contain an outbreak when Roly inadvertently goes on the run with the world's smelliest cheese, earning their Cheese badges in the process.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E11 — The Radio BadgeThe Squirrels stumble upon a room full of old radio equipment and discover that Duggee used to host his own show! Duggee reminisces about his radio days running Clubhouse Radio, playing music, telling jokes, chatting to callers and reading the news. It was the most popular show on air, until a new rival show appeared and replaced him: the tellingly-named Cheese Radio.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E20 — DrivingWith only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E46 — Road TripMum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Middle of the World City, EcuadorAfter hearing about how the Monument to the Equator in Ciudad Mitad del Mundo is in the wrong location, Glitch and his Glitchbots pretend to be the Go Jetters and move the monument onto the equator. But when things start to go wrong, Glitch must learn that some glitches are fine the way they are.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of Mr Tod's TrapWhen Peter, Benjamin and Lily are tempted by a mysterious hoard of radishes, Lily finds herself caught in Mr Tod's trap. Can Peter find a way to rescue Lily before Mr Tod reaches her?

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: S16 E3At 77, Pat searches for the son she placed for adoption at 15. After discovering she could have no more children naturally, she longs to tell her only son she has always loved him. Meanwhile, Jake hopes to reunite with siblings Tom and Katie, whom he has missed since infancy. Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell host.

programme.title: 70 Up: The Victorians
programme.desc: Recently rediscovered and remastered footage of people in their Seventies filmed and broadcast in 1965, the year after the 7 Up documentary that began the Up series. Those involved had been born into Queen Victoria's imperial Britain, when life expectancy was under 50 and workhouses took in the old and destitute. Restored and re-edited, the film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and dying and their hopes in 1965.

programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about 14 seven-year-olds, which became the longest-running documentary series ever. It set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system and that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. This programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what the subjects hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

programme.title: The Living Daylights
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Timothy Dalton and Maryam D'Abo. Agent 007 James Bond encounters a beautiful concert cellist when he is ordered to help a KGB general defect to the West. But the general is later abducted from Britain and Bond embarks on a mission that uncovers illegal arms dealing and diamond smuggling.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S3 E13 — Harry Aikines-AryeeteyPrue is joined by former athlete Harry Aikines-Aryeetey, aka Nitro from Gladiators, who has a recipe for a salted caramel chocolate tart that is a family favourite. She and her husband John visit Highgrove to see the work the King's Foundation is doing to preserve heritage crafts, before they return to the kitchen and Prue shows him how to make a Scandinavian-inspired fish dish.

programme.desc: S2 E1 — England v Spain 26.09England v Spain (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of both teams' opening Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England won promotion to the top division in the 2024/25 campaign by topping a group containing Greece, Republic of Ireland and Finland, and go into this match on the back of finishing third in the summer's World Cup. However, they face a stern test against the Spaniards, who were crowned world champions in the summer, and reached the final of this competition last time out, only losing to Portugal on penalties. With analysis from Ian Wright, Roy Keane and Juan Mata, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: UEFA Nations League: England v Spain
programme.desc: S2 E1 — England v Spain 26.09England v Spain (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of both teams' opening Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England won promotion to the top division in the 2024/25 campaign by topping a group containing Greece, Republic of Ireland and Finland, and go into this match on the back of finishing third in the summer's World Cup. However, they face a stern test against the Spaniards, who were crowned world champions in the summer, and reached the final of this competition last time out, only losing to Portugal on penalties. The last time these teams met was in the Euro 2024 final, when Spain claimed a 2-1 win courtesy of Mikel Oyarzabal's late strike. With analysis from Ian Wright, Roy Keane and Juan Mata, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews from Gabriel Clarke.

After discovering she could have no more children naturally, she longs to tell her only son she has always loved him. Meanwhile, Jake hopes to reunite with siblings Tom and Katie, whom he has missed since infancy. Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell host.

programme.title: 70 Up: The Victorians
programme.desc: Recently rediscovered and remastered footage of people in their Seventies filmed and broadcast in 1965, the year after the 7 Up documentary that began the Up series. Those involved had been born into Queen Victoria's imperial Britain, when life expectancy was under 50 and workhouses took in the old and destitute. Restored and re-edited, the film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and dying and their hopes in 1965.

programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about 14 seven-year-olds, which became the longest-running documentary series ever. It set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system and that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. This programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what the subjects hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

programme.title: The Living Daylights
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Timothy Dalton and Maryam D'Abo. Agent 007 James Bond encounters a beautiful concert cellist when he is ordered to help a KGB general defect to the West. But the general is later abducted from Britain and Bond embarks on a mission that uncovers illegal arms dealing and diamond smuggling.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S3 E13 — Harry Aikines-AryeeteyPrue is joined by former athlete Harry Aikines-Aryeetey, aka Nitro from Gladiators, who has a recipe for a salted caramel chocolate tart that is a family favourite. She and her husband John visit Highgrove to see the work the King's Foundation is doing to preserve heritage crafts, before they return to the kitchen and Prue shows him how to make a Scandinavian-inspired fish dish.

programme.title: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Marlborough SoundsGary and Jason Manford head to Havelock, gateway to the Marlborough Sounds, where local seafood entrepreneur Maegan Blom takes them through a spectacular maze of sheltered waterways, forested hills and peaceful bays. They drop anchor at her working mussel farm to see how greenshell mussels are grown, before heading back to shore for meal. Then they drive their camper van to Picton to board a ferry for the scenic Cook Strait crossing from the South Island to the North Island, heading up to the bridge to meet the captain, before enjoying a sunny beer-tasting out on deck.

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: S1 — Oxford (30min)James is joined by Monica Galetti for a culinary journey around Oxford, where they pay a visit to Raymond Blanc at his restaurant Le Manoir aux Quat'Saisons and sample some of his award-winning dishes. They take a trip up the river to a farm where they pick raspberries for a pudding, and James prepares a chicken dish with morels in the grounds of Raymond's restaurant.

programme.title: UEFA Nations League: England v Spain
programme.desc: S2 E1 — England v Spain 26.09England v Spain (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of both teams' opening Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England won promotion to the top division in the 2024/25 campaign by topping a group containing Greece, Republic of Ireland and Finland, and go into this match on the back of finishing third in the summer's World Cup. However, they face a stern test against the Spaniards, who were crowned world champions in the summer, and reached the final of this competition last time out, only losing to Portugal on penalties. The last time these teams met was in the Euro 2024 final, when Spain claimed a 2-1 win courtesy of Mikel Oyarzabal's late strike. With analysis from Ian Wright, Roy Keane and Juan Mata, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: S16 E3At 77, Pat searches for the son she placed for adoption at 15. After discovering she could have no more children naturally, she longs to tell her only son she has always loved him. Meanwhile, Jake hopes to reunite with siblings Tom and Katie, whom he has missed since infancy. Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell host.

programme.title: 70 Up: The Victorians
programme.desc: Recently rediscovered and remastered footage of people in their Seventies filmed and broadcast in 1965, the year after the 7 Up documentary that began the Up series. Those involved had been born into Queen Victoria's imperial Britain, when life expectancy was under 50 and workhouses took in the old and destitute. Restored and re-edited, the film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and dying and their hopes in 1965.

programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about 14 seven-year-olds, which became the longest-running documentary series ever. It set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system and that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. This programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what the subjects hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

programme.title: The Living Daylights
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Timothy Dalton and Maryam D'Abo. Agent 007 James Bond encounters a beautiful concert cellist when he is ordered to help a KGB general defect to the West. But the general is later abducted from Britain and Bond embarks on a mission that uncovers illegal arms dealing and diamond smuggling.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E5 — DerryDermot O'Leary visits Londonderry, where he heads to the Walled City brewery to find out about the local ingredient behind their standout brews. He then gets in a kayak to take in the skyline from a whole new angle, before getting hands-on with chef Kevin Pyke at Pyke 'N' Pommes, preparing calamari and building tacos.

programme.title: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Marlborough SoundsGary and Jason Manford head to Havelock, gateway to the Marlborough Sounds, where local seafood entrepreneur Maegan Blom takes them through a spectacular maze of sheltered waterways, forested hills and peaceful bays. They drop anchor at her working mussel farm to see how greenshell mussels are grown, before heading back to shore for meal. Then they drive their camper van to Picton to board a ferry for the scenic Cook Strait crossing from the South Island to the North Island, heading up to the bridge to meet the captain, before enjoying a sunny beer-tasting out on deck.

programme.title: The Joy of Pets
programme.desc: S1 E4Gaby Roslin and vet Bolu Eso are in Birmingham celebrating the extraordinary bond between people and animals. At a specialist veterinary hospital, Bolu follows Labrador Bobbie as he undergoes pioneering laser surgery, while another dog presents the team with a neurological mystery. Gaby learns about StreetVet, the charity providing free veterinary care to the pets of people experiencing homelessness.

programme.desc: S1 E12 — Plantation CountryThe chef visits Louisiana, cooks in the historic Houmas House, and samples local speciality gumbo, courtesy of the resident cook. He is also taken on a ghost tour to find out about people who once worked on the property.

programme.title: DinoCity
programme.desc: Have you ever tried to combine things that don't go together? For example, eating soup with marshmallows, putting on a dress with a skirt, or playing... figure hockey! This sport really does exist!

programme.desc: What can be done with things that aren't needed? Give them to someone who needs them. Great idea! All that remains is to find the things that really-really aren't needed.

programme.title: DinoCity

programme.title: DinoCity

programme.title: DinoCity

programme.title: DinoCity

programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4Two of the most produced combat machines in World War II managed to stay relevant until the end of the war through constant modernization and new variants.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E1When WW2 breaks out, an elite force of German U-boat commanders attempt to starve Britain into submission. Vera Mathews heads the reformed WRENS. Meanwhile retired naval commander Gilbert Roberts is desperate to return to his career.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E2After the fall of France in 1940, Dönitz’s trio of aces embark on a race to sink British merchant ships. In Britain, the woman who will frustrate his plans turns the Women’s Royal Naval Service into a force to be reckoned with.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E3When Gilbert Roberts arrives to set up a tactical school for the U-boats, he receives a frosty reception from Admiral Noble. Enlisting the help of Jean Laidlaw and a small team of Wrens, Roberts begins unpicking the flaws in Walker’s ‘Buttercup’.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E4Roberts and Laidlaw have uncovered a flaw in the Royal Navy’s anti-U-boat tactic ‘Buttercup’. By wargaming through different scenarios, they develop a counter-tactic of their own, Codenamed operation ‘Raspberry’.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E5Karl Dönitz fills the ocean with wolfpacks. It's 1943, and with supplies spread thin, pressure mounts on Roberts and the Wrens as they fight to prove the their tactics. Convoy ONS. 5 catches Dönitz’s attention, setting the stage for a pivotal battle.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E6WATU faces a crucial encounter for ONS.5 in the Battle of the Atlantic. Dönitz unleashes the new torpedo that targets the escort ships. Roberts and Laidlaw must counteract the new weapon and recapture the waves.

programme.desc: E4Roberts and Laidlaw have uncovered a flaw in the Royal Navy’s anti-U-boat tactic ‘Buttercup’. By wargaming through different scenarios, they develop a counter-tactic of their own, Codenamed operation ‘Raspberry’.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: E5Karl Dönitz fills the ocean with wolfpacks. It's 1943, and with supplies spread thin, pressure mounts on Roberts and the Wrens as they fight to prove the their tactics. Convoy ONS. 5 catches Dönitz’s attention, setting the stage for a pivotal battle.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E5In spectacular experiments, a team of international experts presents the most significant cases in the history of weapons where speed has made a decisive difference.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E9Wars become even bloodier as new technologies continue to evolve. An international team of experts tests the deadliest weapons upgrades in the history of warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E10Experts look at three types of weapon employed to attack civilian populations, from the medieval trebuchet to modern bio-weapons and nuclear bombs.
